moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing is Back!
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated new series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its launch show this Saturday, introducing the celebrity-pro pairings for 2026.

angles.name: Glitterball Launch
angles.copy: Get ready for sequins and salsa! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show hits our screens this Saturday. Who are you rooting for this year?

angles.name: New Hosts & Celebs
angles.copy: New hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe take the reins as Strictly Come Dancing returns. Plus, a fresh batch of celebs like Lacey Turner and Shaun Wright-Phillips are ready to dance!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is back for its 17th series on Tuesday, with new judge Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood and hosts Alison Hammond and Noel Fielding.

angles.name: Bake Off Tent Reopens
angles.copy: The famous tent reopens! The Great British Bake Off is back on Tuesday. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: New judge alert! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood in the Bake Off tent this year, starting Tuesday on Channel 4. What bakes are you hoping to see?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox
moments.blurb: Astronomical autumn officially begins on Wednesday, September 23rd, marking the moment the Sun crosses the celestial equator.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Break out the jumpers! Astronomical autumn officially arrives on Wednesday. What's your favourite thing about the season?

angles.name: Longer Nights
angles.copy: The Autumn Equinox is this Wednesday, meaning nights will officially start to be longer than days in the Northern Hemisphere. Time to get cosy!

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Rugby Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Gallagher Premiership Rugby season begins this Friday, September 25th, with a double-header including Harlequins vs Bath and Northampton Saints vs Newcastle Red Bulls.

angles.name: Rugby's Back
angles.copy: The wait is over! Gallagher Premiership Rugby kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: Exeter Chiefs in Action
angles.copy: Rugby fans, get ready! The Gallagher Premiership season begins this Friday. Our local Exeter Chiefs are in action on Saturday taking on Gloucester!

moments.title: Happy 57th Birthday, Anastacia
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Anastacia, known for hits like 'I'm Outta Love' and 'Left Outside Alone', celebrates her 57th birthday today.

angles.name: Soprano Soul
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 57th Birthday to the incredible Anastacia! What's your favourite power ballad from her?

moments.title: Happy 75th Birthday, Fee Waybill
moments.blurb: Fee Waybill, the flamboyant lead singer of American rock band The Tubes, turns 75 today.

angles.name: Tubes Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to Fee Waybill, the iconic frontman of The Tubes! 'She's a Beauty' still sounds incredible.

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Day
moments.blurb: Tomorrow is Friday, which means a new Official UK Singles Chart will be announced, revealing the nation's biggest hits.

angles.name: Chart Friday
angles.copy: Tomorrow's Friday, which means a brand new Official UK Singles Chart! Who do you think will be crowned number one?

moments.title: Happy 60th Birthday, Nuno Bettencourt
moments.blurb: Nuno Bettencourt, the acclaimed guitarist of the rock band Extreme, celebrates his 60th birthday this Sunday.

angles.name: Extreme Guitarist
angles.copy: Wishing a rockin' Happy 60th Birthday to Extreme's guitar wizard, Nuno Bettencourt! What's your favourite riff from him?

moments.title: Happy 69th Birthday, Alannah Currie
moments.blurb: Alannah Currie, co-founder and vocalist of the iconic 80s synth-pop band Thompson Twins, turns 69 this Sunday.

angles.name: Thompson Twins Icon
angles.copy: Happy 69th Birthday to the fantastic Alannah Currie of Thompson Twins! Relive the 80s with 'Hold Me Now'!

moments.title: Happy 54th Birthday, Liam Gallagher
moments.blurb: The legendary frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

angles.name: Mad Fer It
angles.copy: C'mon you know! Liam Gallagher turns 54 on Monday. Let's hear it for the Manchester icon!

moments.title: Happy 37th Birthday, Jason Derulo
moments.blurb: Chart-topping American singer-songwriter and dancer Jason Derulo celebrates his 37th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Derulo Turns 37
angles.copy: It's Jason Derulo's 37th birthday on Monday! Which of his catchy hits gets you moving?

moments.title: Happy 68th Birthday, Joan Jett
moments.blurb: Rock icon Joan Jett, known for 'I Love Rock 'n' Roll' and her work with The Runaways, celebrates her 68th birthday on Tuesday.

angles.name: Queen of Rock
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the legendary Joan Jett! Still loving rock 'n' roll after all these years. What's your favourite Jett track?

moments.title: Happy 75th Birthday, David Coverdale
moments.blurb: David Coverdale, the powerful voice behind Deep Purple and Whitesnake, celebrates his 75th birthday on Tuesday.

angles.name: Whitesnake Frontman
angles.copy: Raise a glass to David Coverdale, celebrating his 75th birthday on Tuesday! The Whitesnake and Deep Purple legend still rocks!

moments.title: Happy 68th Birthday, Andrea Bocelli
moments.blurb: World-renowned Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli, celebrated for his classical and pop crossover music, turns 68 on Tuesday.

angles.name: Voice of an Angel
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the magnificent Andrea Bocelli! His voice truly is a gift. What's your favourite of his timeless songs?

moments.title: Happy 58th Birthday, Will Smith
moments.blurb: Actor, rapper, and global superstar Will Smith celebrates his 58th birthday this Friday.

angles.name: Fresh Prince Turns 58
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the Fresh Prince himself, Will Smith! From Bel-Air to blockbusters, what's your favourite Will Smith moment?

moments.title: Happy 33rd Birthday, Rosalía
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning Spanish singer-songwriter Rosalía, known for her innovative fusion of flamenco with contemporary genres, turns 33 this Friday.

angles.name: Motomami Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to the incredible Rosalía! Her music always brings the fire. What's your favourite track from the Motomami star?

moments.title: Happy 33rd Birthday, Teddy Swims
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Teddy Swims, celebrated for his soulful voice and hit 'Lose Control', turns 33 this Friday.

angles.name: Soulful Swims
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 33rd Birthday to the amazing Teddy Swims! 'Lose Control' is still on repeat here. What's your favourite from him?

moments.title: Happy 81st Birthday, Bryan Ferry
moments.blurb: Bryan Ferry, the iconic lead singer of Roxy Music and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 81st birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Roxy Music Legend
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the incomparable Bryan Ferry! The smooth crooner of Roxy Music fame. What's your favourite of his tracks?

moments.title: Happy 45th Birthday, Christina Milian
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actress Christina Milian, known for hits like 'Dip It Low', celebrates her 45th birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Dip It Low Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to Christina Milian! Remember 'Dip It Low'? Still a bop! What's your favourite track from her?
